Default Pyrus agreement upstream app to network-config. (#117)

## Summary
Default Pyrus agreement upstream app to network-config.

## Changes
- Add DEFAULT_AGREEMENT_UPSTREAM_APP and apply it to AgreementConfig defaults.
- Fall back to the server default when agreement upstream_app is absent or blank.
- Assert preview forwards network-config and ignores client x-app overrides.
- Clarify the OpenAPI preview operation description.
